hypotheses.C1_independent_feature_seed: On fresh FineWeb rows, seed-102 semantic top-1 modes have median causal fidelity at least 0.25 and beat their complementary bulk for at least four of five categories.
hypotheses.C2_ood_transfer: On each OOD corpus, eligible semantic top-1 modes have median causal fidelity at least 0.20 and beat bulk for at least three quarters of eligible categories.
hypotheses.C3_semantic_control_advantage: Top-1 semantic median causal fidelity exceeds matched-control fidelity by at least 0.10 on at least two of three corpora.
hypotheses.C4_null_significance: Significant-only semantic modes exceed matched controls by at least 0.10 on at least two of three corpora; zero-significant-mode directions remain zero rather than being silently omitted.
hypotheses.C5_rank1_category_stability: The exact five-category cross-seed matching test for individual leading eigenvectors has p at most 0.05 and at least four of five diagonal matches rank first.
